prerequisites: Send valid JSON for write operations.
Provide teams in Pokemon Showdown export format.

plans.name: Free
plans.requiredFor: All public API operations. No API key, payment method, or paid plan is required.

mechanisms.description: Public API operations are anonymous and keyless. Optional browser-session endpoints use the normal crob.at sign-in flow.

methods.notes: No authentication is required for public endpoints.

methods.bootstrap: Sign in at https://crob.at/login when using optional account or Pokemon Showdown helper endpoints.
methods.notes: The session cookie is for same-origin browser flows and is not an API key.

scopes.notes: Public endpoints have no scopes. Session-aware helpers act only on the signed-in user's account.

economics.freeTier: All documented API operations are free. Public reads and generation require no account. Team creation is limited to 500 requests per hour per client, generated-team saves to 30 per hour, and feedback to 5 per hour.
